_camera_knockback_todo: OQ-CAM-KNOCKBACK (Path A phase 2): view kick per ranged shot, Kenney Starter-Kit-FPS player.gd pattern but recovering. View only: the aim point, Hitscan and the host's aim check never see it. All three knockback values (pitch, yaw, recover) are Shibi-approved industry defaults 2026-10-28, not DESIGN.md values. Still open: per-weapon kick (Kenney's blaster.tres is the 3-pellet weapon; blaster-repeater.tres uses the weapon.gd defaults, ~0.06-0.14 deg), ADS kick, on-device (Fold) check.

camera_knockback_pitch_deg.note: view kick up per ranged shot; Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28 (Shibi's mid-ish pick, not a DESIGN.md value) in Kenney Starter-Kit-FPS weapons/blaster.tres pitch kick min_knockback.x-max_knockback.x 0.025-0.045 rad (1.4-2.6 deg; x = pitch, weapon.gd:18-19), which never recovers there

camera_knockback_yaw_deg.note: sideways view kick per shot, random sign each shot (Kenney random_vec2); Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28 (Shibi's pick, not a DESIGN.md value): softer for third person than Kenney Starter-Kit-FPS weapons/blaster.tres min yaw kick, range min_knockback.y-max_knockback.y 0.025-0.04 rad (1.4-2.3 deg; y = yaw, weapon.gd:18-19)

camera_knockback_recover_s.note: ease-out (quadratic f*f on the remaining fraction) return to rest after the latest kick; 0 turns the knockback off; Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28 (Shibi's pick, not a DESIGN.md value) inside a ~0.2-0.35 s snappy recover band (no single named source); recover_s remains 0.22 (already locked, a220d05). Curve: Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28; quadratic f*f is the EL's concrete form of Shibi's ease-out lock, not a Shibi number or DESIGN.md value

body_layer.note: stage 4 (spec item 3, fixes 1, 3, 10): the render layer of the local player's own third-person body (Body, HeadMesh, SoldierModel meshes, ShotFx tracer and flash; scripts/visual/local_body_layer.gd). A free layer number, not a tuning guess: no other node or camera in the project uses render layers. The local rig camera stops drawing it at the same first-person weight the view model appears (view_model.show_weight), and draws it again below; every other camera keeps the default cull mask and draws it. 0 turns the hide off

view_model._todo: OQ-FIRST-PERSON (M2 C1a stage 2): the first-person view model (scripts/visual/view_model.gd): forearms and the held weapon from the art_astra.json soldier arms, rifle and blade parts. Every value here is a guess for Shibi, not a DESIGN.md value. Positions are view-model metres in the camera's frame (+x right, +y up, -z ahead) BEFORE scale; weapon arm points are in that weapon's hold frame, whose origin is the right hand.

scale.note: guess: the natural-size model is scaled toward the eye by this; the screen image is unchanged, and every vertex stays inside max_reach_m so walls held off by the 0.4 m body capsule never cut it (fix 12 option a: no second camera, no SubViewport)

camera_near_m.note: guess: the rig camera's near plane, set when the view model attaches (Godot's default 0.05); the closest view-model vertex is farther (tests/test_first_person_camera.gd)

max_reach_m.note: guess: test bound: at rest every view-model vertex lies this close to the eye, under the pawn capsule radius 0.4 m (pawn.tscn)

show_weight.note: guess: the model shows from this first-person weight up and rises from below as the weight goes to 1; hidden below it (cover, carrier, falling, downed)

raise_drop_m.note: guess: how far below its pose the model starts when it comes in at show_weight

bob_hz.note: guess: bob cycles per second while walking (one cycle = two steps)
